faq.q: Does it use the Pages Router or App Router?
faq.a: App Router (Next.js 14+ default). The template uses Server Components by default.

faq.q: Can I deploy to Vercel with this?
faq.a: Yes — the generated project works on Vercel out of the box. The Dockerfile is for self-hosted/container deployments.

faq.q: What about middleware, API routes, server actions?
faq.a: The template includes examples in src/app/api/ and src/middleware.ts. Extend as needed.

faq.q: Does it include a database layer (Prisma, Drizzle)?
faq.a: No — the template is unopinionated on data. Add Prisma/Drizzle after generation.
